CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

3. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 11

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 31
   C. 25
   D. 17

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 156

7. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

8. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 6

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 16

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 16

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:

2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 3
3. Product = 24
Final Answer: 24
